    Gateways & LLM Routing

    OpenAI-compatible gateways, routers, guardrail firewalls and free-LLM aggregators.

    6 projects · catalog last checked 2026-10-20. "Highlight" is editorial; status, commit and release come from the weekly evidence refresh.

    Comparison

    Project What it does Highlight (editorial) Deployment Hardware Licence Status
    FreeLLMAPI Aggregates free LLM providers behind one /v1 endpoint with failover Free-tier aggregation self-hosted cpu-ok MIT active
    OpenCode Free Router Routes coding-agent traffic to free model endpoints Free routing for coding agents self-hosted cpu-ok MIT active
    Bifrost High-performance AI gateway with load balancing and fallbacks Low-latency gateway self-hosted cpu-ok Apache-2.0 active
    Trylon Gateway Self-hosted LLM firewall with guardrails Guardrails / security self-hosted cpu-ok BUSL-1.1 ⚠ needs review active
    LiteLLM Proxy + SDK for 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI format, cost tracking Broadest provider coverage self-hosted cpu-ok MIT (enterprise/ dir separate) ⚠ needs review active
    Portkey Gateway Fast AI gateway with routing, retries and caching Edge-friendly gateway self-hosted cpu-ok MIT active

    Quick start

    pip install 'litellm[proxy]'
litellm --model ollama/llama3.2 --port 4000
curl http://localhost:4000/v1/models
    Point any OpenAI SDK at http://localhost:4000/v1.
